candidates.desc: A young man studying at a desk with an open textbook takes a break to look at his phone, laughing at what he sees. His amusement slowly turns into wide-eyed panic as he realizes how much study time his short break has eaten.

A teacher writes a quadratic equation on a chalkboard; every time she turns her back, her class erupts into total chaos with students dancing on desks and throwing paper. When she turns around with her coffee mug, everyone is sitting quietly, leaving her baffled.
A young woman sits at a table at home with an iced coffee, opens her laptop and calmly works through an online course, sipping and typing.
A woman in a mustard coat walks through a grand old library, gazing up in awe at endless shelves and a huge circular tower packed with thousands of books.

A student at a classroom desk needs a straight line but has no ruler. He comically tries the edge of a thick book and a calculator and even searches under the desks, until he finally gets a wooden ruler and happily draws a perfect straight line.

A first-person tour of a school: walking up to the entrance doors at sunrise, through locker-lined hallways, past a classroom of chatting students, the library shelves and the cafeteria line, ending outside on the lawn in front of the school building.

In a hallway of research posters a student glances at one and walks on, but a scientist in a white lab coat and safety glasses stops, inspects every chart up close, points at curves, scribbles notes on a clipboard and beams with excitement.

A young woman in a red beret and glasses studies at a desk stacked with books while her mug of coffee steams; she reads for so long the coffee goes cold, so she comically dumps an ice tray into it, throws the window open and drinks it iced without stopping her studying.

A presenter in a cream blazer shows school subjects in quick cuts: equations on a blackboard, a calculator, paint and brush strokes, piano keys and sheet music, a glowing chemistry flask, then she leans on a stack of textbooks and talks to the camera.

At night a woman in a beanie sets up a telescope on a tripod in her backyard and looks through it at the moon; magnified views show craters and a bright meteor streaking past a crescent moon, and she looks up amazed and tells the camera what she saw.

A student sits at a small desk flipping through an enormous, thick textbook, turning page after page with a bored face; the pages never seem to end, and she finally gives up and falls asleep with her head on the book.

A huge university lecture hall is packed with hundreds of students on laptops and phones in week one; the camera then shows the same auditorium in week five, with row after row of empty seats and only a couple of students left.
A young man in a basketball jersey sits at a dim table completely covered in exam papers and worksheets; he leans over the pages, flips through them and gives up, walking away from the table.

A close-up of a man's hands at a wooden office desk. He holds a small brass gyroscope, a shiny golden ball inside a thin ring, winds a string around its axle and pulls it hard. Then he lowers the gyroscope onto a small golden stand and lets go. The ring turns round and round so fast that it looks blurred, while the whole thing balances upright on the tip of the stand without falling. A grey printer, a pen holder and a roll of paper towels stand in the background.
A man films himself at his kitchen counter presenting his big desk calculator, admits he is bad at math, and demonstratively types 5 + 3 on it to get the answer 8.

In a black-and-white street interview a host quizzes young people with a microphone. A boy answers an easy question and a green 'Correct' pops up twice; a girl struggles with a simple math question and gets a red 'Wrong' before everyone laughs together.

A girl excitedly shows a little Mount Fuji eraser in its Japanese box, then rubs out pencil scribbles on lined paper, leaving a pile of grey shavings. As she uses it the blue eraser wears into a snow-capped mountain shape and she holds up the tiny Fuji proudly.

A tired teenage girl in glasses sits at a desk at night, chin propped on her hand over a pile of worksheets, sighs that tonight she does homework and then more homework, and starts writing with her pen.
A teenage boy sits calmly at his desk with a tablet in a bright classroom while behind him classmates wrestle and pile on top of each other in growing chaos.

A young man in a beanie holds a green click pen up to the camera, clicks the button, then writes stripes in blue, red and other colors on a lined notebook and grins about how cool the multi-color pen is.
A young woman in a beret sketches a mountain landscape with a yellow pencil in an open notebook at a sunny wooden table, while a bearded man watches and applauds her finished drawing.

A stressed student at a desk piled with textbooks and a laptop presses her palms together, looks up at the ceiling and begs "Please, I pray for a good grade... I want to pass my exam". She dramatically pleads into the camera with clasped hands and desperate eyes.

A woman in a lab coat, safety goggles and purple gloves says she loves science, mixes two blue liquids in a beaker, and a huge tower of orange foam erupts out of it; she reacts wide-eyed with delight and holds up the foam-filled tube in triumph.

At a wooden table on a grassy steppe with a horse grazing behind, a young woman shows a blunt pencil, a man twists it in a small sharpener so a wood shaving curls out, and she holds up the now needle-sharp pencil before drawing in a notebook.
Two teenagers recline in planetarium seats as the dome above them fills with a glowing Milky Way star field; they gaze up open-mouthed while the galaxy slowly drifts overhead.

In a school gym a boy in white PE kit shuffles his trainers forward until his toes touch a coloured line painted on the parquet floor; the camera then pans along a whole class of boys standing shoulder to shoulder with every pair of shoes exactly on the same line, forming one perfectly straight row, while a teacher in a red tracksuit with a whistle walks down the line checking it.

In a tiered lecture hall a young woman in a mustard jumper and round glasses sits at a desk in the middle rows, throws one arm straight up and speaks towards the front, eyebrows up. Around her the other students sit taking notes. Then more and more hands go up around her, until in the last shots the whole hall — row after row of students — has a hand in the air, all looking towards the front and speaking at once.

In a classroom a girl in a mustard jumper holds a small white bone up close to the camera between her finger and thumb, other pupils working at desks behind her. She turns to a hanging plastic skeleton and lifts a long thigh bone off a grey tray with both hands, turning it so the knobbly ends show; more long bones lie on the tray beside her. The scene cuts to a museum hall where she looks up open-mouthed at the huge mounted skeleton of a dinosaur and points up at its ribcage.

A school classroom during class. Two teenagers lean over an open spiral notebook on a desk; the pages are covered in handwritten algebra. The boy in glasses points at a line with a blue pen and the girl writes. Behind them the room is full of desks. A boy walks up the side of the room and lobs a balled-up sheet of paper at a grey bin by the whiteboard; the students at the desks turn and laugh. A wide shot shows the whole class seated in rows, writing in their books.

A sunny asphalt school yard fenced in behind a low building. A girl in denim dungarees with yellow ribbons in her bunches runs up and then hops along a hopscotch grid chalked on the ground, landing with both feet in the numbered squares. Other children swing a long skipping rope to one side, a boy bounces a ball at the back and a teacher watches from behind. At the end her friends rush in and pile into a laughing group hug around her.

A red-haired woman in a khaki shirt and bush hat lies over a patch of desert sand and sweeps a wide brush across it, uncovering a small round coin. She brushes again and the sand falls away from a flat grey slab. The slab turns out to be a stone tablet carved with rows of hieroglyphs, and she scrapes along its edge with a pointed trowel, mouth open in amazement. Finally she stands in a sandy excavation pit beside a colossal carved pharaoh's head, with other workers climbing over the stone around it.

On a sunny university lawn a blonde student in a white crop top leans far to one side towards the camera and laughs; her friends lean the same way beside her; the camera pulls back to show dozens of students on the grass all leaning sideways in the same pose, with big shade trees, walkways and university buildings behind them.

Seen from behind, a student in a grey hoodie with a backpack runs along a sunlit path across a university campus. He hurries down the aisle of a full lecture theatre towards the speaker at the lectern. A close-up shows his hand writing lines in blue pen in a spiral notebook, with a yellow highlighter and a laptop beside it. A stack of library books and a steaming paper coffee cup stand on a table between the shelves. In the last shot he stands up at his classroom desk with his fist in the air, a paper marked with a large red A on the desk in front of him, while the other students clap and cheer.

In a fairy-lit cafe a curly-haired woman sits at a table with small national flags and thick decorated dictionaries, greets the camera brightly, then jumps up and runs across the room. She sits down opposite a woman in a kimono who bows with pressed palms over an open book, then stands holding a huge stack of dictionaries, each spine carrying a different language. At the end the whole cafe raises coffee cups around her and her tower of books.

In a courtyard between brightly painted apartment blocks a young man in a rust hoodie tries to juggle two balls, fumbles and grabs his head in embarrassment while a young woman in a denim jacket beside him holds more balls and shows him how. He tries again, tossing one ball up and catching it, gets a little further each time, and at the end both of them laugh and she claps.

In a meadow full of wild flowers a young woman in an olive rain jacket and a cap, her red hair in plaits, crouches down to a fallen wooden log lying in the grass. She holds a magnifying glass over a small green insect sitting on the bark and moves in close, her eye almost against the lens, studying it from a few centimetres away. Then she turns to an open notebook lying in the grass, full of pencil drawings of insects, and adds a new sketch with her pencil.

Two teenage boys in navy school hoodies meet in a school corridor lined with coloured lockers and do a clasped-hand shake, laughing. Outside they sit on a wooden bench with their backpacks open, unwrapping a sandwich and holding a red apple while they talk. The shot then widens to the school field, where a crowd of students in the same navy uniform play football on the grass in front of the school building.

A young woman in a beige trench coat stands at a glass tram shelter and runs her finger down a printed timetable, then looks at her wristwatch and smiles. At a station concourse she reads a large departure board full of times and writes in a small spiral notepad. Back on the platform she compares the posted timetable with her watch again while a red train pulls in behind her.

In a sunny seminar room with a tall sash window, a bookcase with files and a trailing plant, a young man in a navy jumper stands by the shelves holding a pen and listens. A young woman with long braids, in a mustard jumper and dark jeans, stands by the window and replies to him, gesturing with an open hand as she explains. A young woman in a lilac jumper sits at the round wooden table and writes notes, among notebooks, water bottles and coffee cups.

A quiet library reading room is seen through a doorway framed by bookshelves, and the view moves into the room. A young woman with long curly dark hair, in a beige knitted top and trousers, rides a wooden book trolley down the aisle with her arms flung up, shouting with joy, while books lie scattered on the herringbone floor. Students at long desks with green lamps turn and stare at her, and a man in a suit appears behind her. A sign asking for silence hangs in front of tall shelves.

In a plain classroom with tall windows, a teacher in a white shirt points at circles drawn on a whiteboard. At a wooden desk a young woman in a cream knitted jumper rests her cheek on her hand with half-closed eyes, slowly falls asleep with her head on the desk, jerks up wide awake, then props her chin on her hands and closes her eyes again. Behind her a young man in a navy T-shirt sleeps with his head on his arms. A paper coffee cup and an open empty notebook with a pen lie on the desks.

A scene from the Ice Age, seen from inside a rocky cave mouth. A young woman and a young man in thick fur clothes and fur boots walk through deep snow towards the front, pulling a wooden sledge loaded with sticks, and the man smiles. A woolly mammoth with long curved tusks stomps along the frozen river behind them. A fire burns in the cave, an animal hide is stretched on a wooden rack, a hide tent stands on the shore, and huge blue glaciers rise under a cloudy golden sky.

An old-fashioned chemistry lab with tall windows and a brass chandelier. A black and white border collie in a white lab coat stands up at a wooden bench and pours a clear liquid from a glass jug into a flask held in a metal stand, and the liquid turns bright purple and starts to bubble. A young woman in a lab coat and dark red jumper laughs beside it and then holds the glowing flask while the dog watches. A stoneware bottle, a rack of test tubes and a small brown bottle stand around them.

A pebble beach below tall layered cliffs on a windy sunny day. A young woman in a mustard jumper and navy trousers holds up a round stone with a spiral fossil in it and points along the beach, then points at the fossil while showing it to a young woman in a light blue jacket who leans in to look. A young man in a dark red jumper crouches and picks up other stones. A canvas bag with a notebook and a small hammer lies on a flat rock, and waves break behind them.

A quiet old library with tall arched windows, dark bookshelves and an upper gallery with an iron railing. At a long wooden table a young man in a cream cable-knit jumper sneezes hard into his hand and his papers fly up into the air and land on the table. The young woman next to him leans back with her mouth wide open, a young man behind her rubs his face, and a woman in a dark blazer stares. Up on the gallery an older woman in a lilac cardigan leans over the railing and watches.

A university lecture room with a big green chalkboard and wooden desks. A young woman in a beige blazer and black trousers lunges forward and presses a piece of chalk hard into one tiny spot in the middle of the board, with chalk dust bursting out and straight chalk lines running outwards from that single spot like a star. She then steps back, stands up straight and brushes the chalk off her hands. Chalk crumbs lie on the floor, and two students stand back behind her, one holding a long wooden pointer.

A grand wood-panelled library with tall windows and green desk lamps. A young woman in a cream cardigan, navy skirt and black loafers kneels on the herringbone floor and very carefully gathers a tall, wobbly stack of heavy books into her arms, then slowly lifts it against her chest, her face tense as she tries not to make a sound. Around her students read and write at long tables without looking up, a man climbs a tall wooden ladder at the shelves, and a book trolley stands nearby.
